assessments.evidence: Provincial capital of Kasai-Central with governorate, PNC provincial commissariat and district commissariats, FARDC military region HQ and ANR. Kamuina Nsapu militias attacked the city (incl. airport) in early 2017 but were repulsed and dispersed by mid-2017; since then no armed group holds any neighbourhood, with insecurity limited to banditry/street gangs handled by the PNC. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by egress proxy).

units.CD9101-kananga: Kananga is the provincial capital of Kasai-Central and is firmly state-held. The Kamuina Nsapu insurgency of 2016-2017 reached the city (attacks in Nganza and on the airport in 2017) but was defeated and dispersed, and no armed group has held any part of the city since. Urban neighbourhoods are policed by the PNC, with FARDC (military region HQ and camps such as Camp Kamayi) and ANR presence; insecurity is mostly banditry and street gangs. Peri-urban villages fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so the assessment relies on background knowledge and confidence is limited.
